evidence.quote:
A rollback
we have not rehearsed is a rollback we do not actually have.

observations.why: Directive sets a recurring mandate by position authority (legitimate) while the aphoristic second sentence elevates rehearsal to an existential necessity, appealing to shared values of preparedness (inspirational-appeal).
Structural label asserting a fixed cadence performs legitimate authority — scheduling as mandate, not proposal.
Assigning ownership by structural label exercises legitimate authority — naming the accountable party as a directive act.

mints.name: MandateAsAphorism
mints.title: a rollback we have not rehearsed is a rollback we do not actually have
mints.frame: Is the directive here being sealed by an aphoristic reformulation that makes non-compliance unthinkable, rather than by argument or threat?
